title: unified-rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow auto-rollback enhancements
author: Nina Ramos
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and signal fidelity for automated rollback workflows across canary, A/B and shadow rollout modes. We have seen two classes of incidents: (1) noisy shadow traffic causing false-positive rollbacks due to metric mismatch, and (2) flapping during rapid consecutive rollouts when metrics are borderline. This PR introduces multi-metric matching, adaptive windowing, and safety gates to reduce accidental rollbacks while preserving fast recovery from real regressions.

What this PR does: - Adds metric matcher that supports weighted multi-metric evaluation and per-metric thresholds. - Introduces adaptive evaluation windows (short window for latency spikes, longer for noisy metrics like loss) and an exponential backoff plus sticky-rollout policy to prevent flapping. - Extends shadow logic to optionally filter synthetic traffic and to use separate shadow buckets for A/B experiments to avoid cross-contamination of observability signals. - Adds canary weight ramp guardrails and a global kill-switch route for emergency manual overrides. - Improves telemetry: new rollback_reason tags, rollback_score histogram and per-rollout debug traces. - Adds unit, integration, and e2e tests for the new behaviors and updates docs + runbook.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-2184) [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] e2e tests added [x] telemetry/metrics updated [x] docs/runbook updated

Commits summary: - commit 1: rollout: add multi-metric matcher and config schema updates - commit 2: rollout: adaptive evaluation windowing + exponential backoff - commit 3: shadow: isolate shadow buckets and synthetic traffic filter - commit 4: telemetry: add rollback_score + tags + provenance - commit 5: tests: add integration and e2e coverage for canary/AB/shadow rollback flows - commit 6: docs: runbook and examples updated

High-level files changed: services/rollout/controller.go, pkg/rollout/strategy/autorollback.go, pkg/rollout/matcher/multi_metric.go, pkg/rollout/matcher/multi_metric_test.go, examples/rollouts/canary-ab-shadow.yaml, tests/e2e/rollout_autorollback_test.go, docs/runbooks/unified-rollouts.md, observability/metrics/rollback_metrics.prom, charts/redwood-helm/values-rollouts.yaml, .github/workflows/rollout-e2e.yml

Notes on compatibility: Config schema changes are additive (new optional fields under rollout.strategy.autoRollback and shadow.filter). Existing rollouts with no config keep previous semantics. Operators can opt-in to the new matcher via rollout spec.

Testing and perf: Unit + integration run locally and on CI. E2E runs were added that simulate golden traffic, synthetic noise, and shadow-only experiments. Micro-benchmarks for matcher are included; matcher adds ~1.2ms median overhead in the controller loop (safe within SLOs).

Rollback behavior examples (user-facing): - Canary detects latency spike > threshold and triggers rollback after adaptive grace window. - Shadow-only anomalies are suppressed when synthetic traffic ratio > configured threshold. - AB experiments evaluate metrics per-variant and do not aggregate shadowed telemetry across variants.

Release notes: See release_notes field.

merge_description: Squashed and merged main feature commits; kept individual commit messages in PR history.
release_notes:
- Enhanced auto-rollback for unified rollouts: multi-metric matching, adaptive windows, and exponential backoff to prevent flapping.
- Shadow traffic filtering and isolated buckets for cleaner observability during experiments.
- New telemetry: rollback_score histogram and rollback_reason tags.
- Opt-out: rollout.strategy.autoRollback.enableMatcher=false for customers requiring legacy behavior.
notes: This change is additive and safe to roll out. Operators should review the updated runbook before enabling matcher in production clusters.
safety_risks: Low: changes add additional checks and safety gates. The exponential backoff prevents oscillation; emergency manual kill-switch retained.
rollback_guidance: If you observe false suppression of rollbacks, temporarily set rollout.strategy.autoRollback.enableMatcher=false and file an incident with ENG-2184 reference.
